Title: Public Preview: Azure Container Apps adds support for agentic Docker Compose

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps is bringing the familiar developer workflow of Docker Compose directly to Azure Container Apps. As one of the most widely adopted tools among developers, Docker Compose simplifies defining and running multi-container applications, and this new integration extends that ease of use to production environments. With native support in Azure Container Apps, developers can now move seamlessly from local development to cloud deployment without changing their tooling or workflow. When combined with serverless GPU support, agentic Docker Compose enables rapid iteration and scalable execution of AI-powered agents and applications. With this update, customers can now experience a developer-first platform for modern AI workloads, unifying the inner-loop and outer-loop experience into a single, consistent environment.  

Learn more.
